summary: Independent verifier re-ran the task checks, inspected the contract schemas, validator, examples, tests, evidence manifests, and mapped every acceptance criterion to registered evidence.

criteria.criterion: Every Goal criterion must map to at least one Claim and uncovered criteria fail validation.
criteria.notes: Goal criterion coverage is implemented by deterministic contract validation and tested by the uncovered-criterion case.

criteria.criterion: Every required Claim must map to a Gate or explicit approval requirement.
criteria.notes: Required claims must have a gateRef or approvalRequired; the required-claim-without-gate test fails closed.

criteria.criterion: Claim dependencies are checked for cycles and missing references.
criteria.notes: Missing dependencies and cyclic dependencies are both covered by deterministic validator tests.

criteria.criterion: Security and governance Claim requirements cannot be downgraded by extension fields.
criteria.notes: Security and governance claims cannot be made optional or weakened through extension-field override paths.

criteria.criterion: Schemas reject unknown major versions and malformed IDs while allowing compatible extension fields.
criteria.notes: Schemas reject unknown major versions and malformed IDs, while compatible x-* extension fields validate.

criteria.criterion: Contract tests include valid, uncovered, cyclic, duplicate, and forbidden-downgrade cases.
criteria.notes: Contract tests include valid, uncovered, cyclic, duplicate, and forbidden-downgrade cases.

criteria.criterion: No model/provider SDK is imported by the domain or validation layer.
criteria.notes: Targeted tests and contract lint found no model/provider SDK imports in the domain or validation layer.

commands.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_acceptance_contracts tests.test_schemas -v

commands.notes: AHRA lint 0 failures and schema examples OK.
All artifact-manifest and evidence-manifest hashes matched local files.
